How to incorporate a huge, exciting new concept (like BMASS) into your project without having to rebuild everything from scratch. This requires mapping the external idea onto current components rather than letting it demand entirely new infrastructure.

The 'stolen substrate pattern' approach: Taking the core structure or successful pattern of an outside idea and forcing it to fit neatly into one of your existing, proven parts. This acknowledges value while maintaining architectural discipline.
